title: Things to interact with in a region
description: interactables/<region>.json, written by hand beside the region file the painting workspace generates (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-tactics-interactables-design.md). Documentation only: the C# loader (Tactics.Logic PackLoader, Validation and InteractableKinds) is the authority and also checks meaning: what each kind allows, where a thing stands, that it can be reached, and that every lock has a way through it. Not part of the battle hash.

region.description: The region the things stand in.

id.description: Unique across the whole pack: the campaign keeps each thing's state by it.

at.description: Its world tile: walkable ground, outside every stamp, off the spawns and the beat spots.

name.description: What it's called on the button and the TV ("old chest"); the kind's name when left out.

art.description: An art key, without its state. Required for an ambient thing, which has no art of its kind.

text.description: A readable's words, a shrine's lines, an ambient thing's bark. Required for readables and shrines.

requires.description: Story flags that must all be set for it to be there.

unless.description: Story flags that take it away.

sets.description: Flags its main outcome sets: opened, read, taken, used, or a lever first turned on. A key is a flag a thing sets.

key.description: The story flag that's its key.

keyName.description: The key's name on the button ("iron key").

seal.description: Arcana DC, for a magic seal.

lock.description: Containers and passages only. At least one way through it. A failed check is spent for this lock.

spot.description: The passive Perception DC that sees it.

disarm.description: Sleight of Hand DC to take it apart. Required on a floor trap.

text.description: What's said when it goes off.

sets.description: Flags set when it goes off.

injury.description: An injury id given to whoever sprang it. Supported, unused until the user decides (design, USER DECISION 3).

lose.description: An item id, one of which leaves the bag of whoever sprang it. Supported, unused until the user decides.

hidden.description: The passive Perception DC that finds it. Required for a cache and a secret door.

loot.description: What a container holds or a pickup is. It goes to the leader's bag.

targets.description: For a lever: the passages of this region it opens when on and shuts when off.

open.description: A passage that starts open, or a lever that starts on.

blocks.description: Whether it stands in the way; the kind's when left out. Not for passages or floor traps.
